title: Unified Routing
description: Unified Routing is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Routes every request to the right backend by path and version. Routes are declared as path patterns with backends; the longest match wins. It takes route table and produces routed requests. Tunable parameters: per path. Guarantee: unmatched paths always get a clear 404.

fields.mechanism: Routes are declared as path patterns with backends; the longest match wins.
fields.guarantees: unmatched paths always get a clear 404

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Central Auth
description: Central Auth is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Authenticates once at the gateway for all backends. Tokens are validated centrally; backends receive a trusted identity header. It takes tokens and produces identity. Tunable parameters: per request. Guarantee: backends never see raw credentials.

fields.mechanism: Tokens are validated centrally; backends receive a trusted identity header.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Rate Limiting
description: Rate Limiting is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Enforces per-key rate limits across all APIs. Limits are counted centrally so one key cannot dodge limits by switching APIs. It takes keys and produces limits. Tunable parameters: per key. Guarantee: limits are always exact, never approximate.

fields.mechanism: Limits are counted centrally so one key cannot dodge limits by switching APIs.
fields.guarantees: limits are always exact, never approximate

title: Response Caching
description: Response Caching is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Caches GET responses to protect backends. Cache keys include path, query, and identity scope; TTLs are per route. It takes responses and produces cache. Tunable parameters: per route. Guarantee: cached responses always carry their age.

fields.mechanism: Cache keys include path, query, and identity scope; TTLs are per route.

title: Request Tracing
description: Request Tracing is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Traces every request across all backends with one id. A trace id is minted at the edge and propagated; spans assemble into one view. It takes requests and produces traces. Tunable parameters: per request. Guarantee: traces never lose a span.

fields.mechanism: A trace id is minted at the edge and propagated; spans assemble into one view.

title: Protocol Translation
description: Protocol Translation is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Translates between REST, gRPC, and GraphQL at the edge. Clients speak their protocol; the gateway translates to the backend's. It takes protocols and produces translated calls. Tunable parameters: per route. Guarantee: translations never drop fields.

title: Schema Validation
description: Schema Validation is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Validates requests and responses against published schemas. Schemas are registered per route; invalid requests fail fast with details. It takes schemas and produces validation. Tunable parameters: per route. Guarantee: failures always name the bad field.

title: Canary Routing
description: Canary Routing is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Sends a slice of traffic to new backend versions. Traffic splits by percentage or header; the split is observable live. It takes backends and produces split traffic. Tunable parameters: per route. Guarantee: splits never exceed the configured share.

title: Circuit Breaking
description: Circuit Breaking is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Stops calling backends that are failing. Consecutive failures trip the breaker; half-open probes test recovery. It takes health and produces breaker state. Tunable parameters: per backend. Guarantee: breakers always recover automatically.

fields.mechanism: Consecutive failures trip the breaker; half-open probes test recovery.

title: API Key Scopes
description: API Key Scopes is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Scopes each key to exactly the routes it needs. Keys carry scope lists; out-of-scope requests are rejected at the edge. It takes keys and produces scoped access. Tunable parameters: per key. Guarantee: keys never gain scope silently.

fields.mechanism: Keys carry scope lists; out-of-scope requests are rejected at the edge.

title: Usage Metering
description: Usage Metering is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Meters every API call for billing and analytics. Calls are counted by key, route, and status; meters feed invoices. It takes calls and produces meters. Tunable parameters: per call. Guarantee: meters never double-count retries.

title: Mock Backends
description: Mock Backends is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Serves mock responses for backends under development. Mocks are declared per route with example payloads; they swap for real on ready. It takes mocks and produces mock responses. Tunable parameters: per route. Guarantee: mocks are always labeled.

title: Version Negotiation
description: Version Negotiation is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Serves the right API version per client. Clients request a version; the gateway routes to it or the nearest compatible. It takes versions and produces routed version. Tunable parameters: per client. Guarantee: incompatible versions always get 406.

title: DDoS Shields
description: DDoS Shields is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Absorbs abusive traffic before it reaches backends. Rate anomalies trigger challenges; backends see only clean traffic. It takes traffic and produces filtered flow. Tunable parameters: auto. Guarantee: legitimate bursts are never blocked.

title: Gateway Config GitOps
description: Gateway Config GitOps is a integration ability in the Universal API Gateway Integration database. Manages all gateway config as versioned code. Routes, limits, and keys live in git; changes roll out through review. It takes repo and produces config. Tunable parameters: versioned. Guarantee: the running config always matches a commit.
